verdict.rationale: ADP's own docs for RUN say you can "Pay employees and contractors" from the same payroll product. RUN also creates and e-files both W-2 and 1099 forms, so W-2 and 1099 workers are handled on one platform. missing for 10: detailed docs on how contractor payments work (payment method, onboarding), independent or hands-on confirmation of paying contractors in RUN, and 1099 form delivery is an additional fee.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Pay employees and contractors, have payroll taxes calculated, filed and paid for you
We’ll create and deliver W-2 and 1099 forms for you (additional fee), and even e-file these forms with the IRS on your behalf.
Employees can view pay history and up to three years of W-2s/1099s
